mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, which reduces discount rates on future corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines over 3 months, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% within a single month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which increases recession risk and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential construction (HOUST) and real personal consumption (RSAFS) signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 50% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 for two consecutive months indicates a contraction in real output, which signals a weakening economy and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 1-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% combined with a decline in CPIAUCSL below 3.0% signals a disinflationary monetary tightening, which reduces equity risk premiums and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression model.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS) below 50k in a single month, combined with a rising unemployment rate, signals labor market weakness and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the joint effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in real personal consumption (RSAFS) below its 12-month moving average, combined with a drop in housing starts (HOUST) below 1.4 million units, signals a broad-based demand slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in less than 50% of instances when both conditions are met, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05) in a regression.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 102 for three consecutive months, combined with a drop in GDP (GDPC1) below 1.0% annualized, signals a deepening supply-side contraction and triggers negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 50% of triggered instances, or the interaction term is not significant (p > 0.05) in a multivariate model.
